rust_summary: a player started spectating an entity, heard once the camera is set (`native_player_start_spectating_entity`); the start of what `native_player_stop_spectating_entity` ends.
doc_summary: `native_player_start_spectating_entity(player, name, entity_id, kind)` tells a mod that a server player started spectating `entity_id`, whose entity type is `kind` (`minecraft:player` for another player), after their camera was set to it. It is the start of `native_player_stop_spectating_entity`, which still gives the same id when the player stops. Heard on a server, once per camera change. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_start_spectating_entity@.
